description: The nodes of a scene file: names, classes and hierarchy, with properties when asked. A node that instances another scene names that file under instanceOf, and the nodes listed under it come from that file rather than this one; its editableChildren says whether this scene, or a scene it inherits, keeps values of its own for them (scene_node set editableChildren). A node in any group answers groups, sorted, from this file and every scene it comes from. Needs no editor: one serving the project answers and says whether it holds unsaved changes to the scene, and with none a headless engine reads the file without making its nodes, so no script of theirs runs (autoloads still start once it has answered, as in every headless call). For the nodes of a game that is running, runtime_inspect tree.

depth.description: How many levels to descend. Default: all. A node at the last level that has children of its own lists none and says how many under childrenNotListed.

includeProperties.description: Include each node's properties. Default false.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".
